rationale: Probably substantivization of Greek παλαμᾶσθαι 'to contrive, work craftily.' Used here in the cosmogonic context of Matter's emanations. Confidence low; could alternatively be a proper name.

Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲧⲁⲕⲟ ('destroy') = 'destroyer.' Standard agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' Listed among the dark monsters (with dragons and beasts) born from Matter's deep.
Reduplicated form related to ⲕⲣⲙⲉⲥ 'smoke' / ⲕⲙⲏⲙⲉ 'darkness' — qualitative 'darkened, smoke-coloured, dusky.' Describes the appearance of Matter's monstrous offspring.
Probable qualitative from root ⲃⲱⲧⲉ 'abomination, foul thing.' Modifies ⲙⲟⲣⲫⲁⲩⲉ 'forms' to describe the loathsome shapes of Matter's offspring in the darkness.
Auxiliary verb construction with ⲁⲣ̄ ⲟⲩⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ 'to make war.' Possibly related to ϫⲡⲓⲟ 'be ready, undertake' or ϣⲉⲛ-ⲍⲏⲧ 'be eager.' Confidence low.
